example_zh: 由於受到污染，樹木的表皮幾乎完全剝落。

example_en: One of the players was injured during the match, so a sub was brought on.
example_zh: 比賽中一個隊員受傷，於是一個替補隊員頂上。

chinese_meaning: 訂閱，訂購（產品）;（為某項服務）定期付費;定期捐助
example_en: 2.3 million people subscribe to this online music service.
example_zh: 有230萬人訂購了這個線上音樂服務。

example_en: I decided to take out (= pay for) a subscription to a gardening magazine.
example_zh: 我決定訂一本園藝雜誌。

example_en: The singer was interviewed in his hotel suite.
example_zh: 這位歌手在飯店套房裡接受採訪。

example_en: surgical supplies/instruments/gloves, etc.
example_zh: 手術器材／器械／手套（等等）

chinese_meaning: （尤指員警或軍隊的）監視，盯梢
example_en: The police have kept the nightclub under surveillance because of suspected illegal drug activity.
example_zh: 這家夜總會因涉嫌非法毒品活動而被警方監視。

example_en: The suspension of fighting is to take effect at 6 a.m. on Monday.
example_zh: 停戰協定於週一早上六點生效。

chinese_meaning: 併發症，症候群，綜合症狀
example_en: Early diagnosis of the syndrome is difficult, but it is important to begin treatment as soon as possible.
example_zh: 此症候群的早期診斷很困難，但盡快開始治療很重要。
